linkHealth.title: Status & relations
linkHealth.sectionHint: Checks whether entries, dispatch channels, and nodes are ready, with next-step guidance
linkHealth.stateOkDetail: Entries, dispatch channels, and nodes are ready
linkHealth.guideNoMenuEntry: In the channel menu editor, add an open-workflow entry that selects this workflow, save, and publish.
linkHealth.guideChannelUnreachable: If the network is restricted, configure a proxy in the Network tab of settings
linkHealth.guideChannelTokenInvalid: Replace the token in the channel edit dialog
linkHealth.guideChannelCheckFailed: Check the error, or configure a proxy and retry
linkHealth.guideTopicNoReadyNode: Make sure this dispatch channel has a subscribing compute node that is online; enable the node in the compute node list, or check agent heartbeat and the Comfy service.
linkHealth.guideNoCaseRoutes: Add a routing rule in this workflow's processing flow that points a condition to this dispatch channel, save, then re-check.
linkHealth.guideNoEdgeSubscribers: Select this dispatch channel in the compute node's Deploy dialog, copy the deploy command, and rerun it; create a compute node first if none are available.
linkHealth.guideSubscribersOffline: Check that subscribing compute nodes' edge-agent is running, the control plane is reachable, and the Comfy service is healthy.
linkHealth.guideNoTopicBinding: Select at least one dispatch channel in the node's Deploy dialog, copy the deploy command, and rerun it.
linkHealth.guideNoCaseReachable: Configure routing rules in this workflow's processing flow so tasks are dispatched to this node through subscribed dispatch channels.
linkHealth.guideEdgeNotReady: First confirm the compute node is enabled; if it is still offline, check the edge-agent process, network, and Comfy service, then wait for heartbeat to recover.
linkHealth.guideCaseMissing: This workflow no longer exists — recreate it in the workflow list or select another entity.
linkHealth.guideEdgeMissing: This node no longer exists — recreate it in the node list or select another entity.
linkHealth.noMenuEntry: No menu entry — users cannot reach this case
linkHealth.noCaseRoutes: No workflow routes to this dispatch channel
linkHealth.noTopicBinding: This compute node subscribes to no dispatch channels
linkHealth.noCaseReachable: No workflow routes tasks to this node
linkHealth.edgeNotReady: Compute node is not ready (disabled or offline)
linkHealth.topicNoReadyNode: Dispatch channel {{topic}} has no online compute node
linkHealth.noEdgeSubscribers: No compute node subscribes to this dispatch channel
linkHealth.subscribersOffline: All subscribing compute nodes are offline
